senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. ערר)to be rough; to be in commotion.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 5:7">Kil. V, 7</cite> <he>וסִיעַרְתּוֹ הרוח לאחריו</he> and the wind drove the seed backward; <cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 3:12">Tosef. ib. III, 12</cite> <cite ref="O00638"><he>סייתו</he></cite>, <he>סייעתו</he>, <he>הסעורתו</he> ed. Zuck. (corr. acc., v. infra).
